title: How to Get Found on LinkedIn Before Everyone Else!
description:
Trying to get found by recruiters on LinkedIn? I’m showing you four overlooked LinkedIn fixes that can make you easier to find — including a sneaky workaround that gives you basically the same result as a Premium LinkedIn feature without paying for Premium.

You’ll learn how to use your Featured section as proof, clean up your LinkedIn URL, check the visibility settings that may be hiding you, set up Open to Work correctly, and reverse-engineer the profiles of people already getting hired into the jobs you want.

Your profile should not just tell people what you do. It should help you get found — and give employers a reason to believe you when they do.

 GET SEEN GUIDE — RESUME + COVER LETTER HELP

Getting found is only half the battle. My Get Seen Guide walks you step by step through creating a resume and cover letter that clearly sells why you’re worth interviewing!

https://katekirchner.thinkific.com/products/digital_downloads/resume-and-cover-letter-writing-guide

Need personalized career coaching?
https://kirchnercareers.com

 Connect with me on LinkedIn:
https://www.linkedin.com/in/kate-kirchner/

I’m Kate Kirchner, career strategist and your career bestie. Subscribe for practical LinkedIn tips, resume strategies, interview help, and no-BS job-search advice.
